mutations.name: a coordinator may not resolve the ci-policy-budget row
kills: a coordinator resolving a CI-policy gate admits a ci-policy-budget gate on fresh merge evidence

mutations.name: a required check removed reads as budget
mutations.find: return lost === undefined ? undefined : `required check ${lost} was removed or renamed`;
kills: sorting a weakened CI-policy diff into budget or weakening reads a required-check removal as weakening, naming the check
sorting a weakened CI-policy diff into budget or weakening reads a required check renamed away as weakening

mutations.name: a .github/ file with no structural reader reads as budget
mutations.find: return { why: `${shownLine(file.path)} is not the budget data file or a workflow, so its change is not read as budget` };
kills: sorting a weakened CI-policy diff into budget or weakening reads a .github/ file with no structural reader beside a budget bump as weakening

mutations.name: a workflow key outside its jobs may change
mutations.find: if (!isDeepStrictEqual(without(base, "jobs"), without(head, "jobs"))) return why("more than its jobs' timeouts");
kills: sorting a weakened CI-policy diff into budget or weakening reads a workflow by its parsed structure, so a top-level timeout-minutes is weakening

mutations.name: a timeout may be removed or set to anything
kills: sorting a weakened CI-policy diff into budget or weakening reads a workflow by its parsed structure, so a removed timeout is weakening

mutations.name: a changed path outside the classified files reads as budget
mutations.find: if (outside !== undefined) return weakening(`the PR changes ${shownLine(outside)}, which is not a classified .github/ file`);
kills: sorting a weakened CI-policy diff into budget or weakening reads a #3117-shaped diff with a vitest.config.ts change beside it as weakening
